findings.label: Non-atomic artist apply
findings.detail: apply() calls artistProfile.create then user.update({ role: 'ARTIST' }) in two separate operations. A failure between them leaves the user with an ArtistProfile but LISTENER role, permanently locking them out of GET /artists/me and PATCH /artists/me. Fix: wrap both writes in this.prisma.$transaction([...]).

findings.label: unfollowArtist counter can go negative
findings.detail: The existence check runs outside the transaction. Two concurrent unfollow calls can both pass the findUnique check; the second delete inside the transaction throws P2025, but totalFollowers may have already been decremented. The Int column has no non-negative constraint, so the counter can go negative.

findings.label: genre filter silently ignored on unknown slug
findings.detail: In TracksService.getPublishedTracks, if query.genre is provided but the genre is not found, the filter is silently dropped and the full published catalogue is returned. A caller filtering by ?genre=typo receives all tracks with no indication the filter was ignored.

findings.label: getTrending fallback discards recent results
findings.detail: When fewer than limit tracks exist in the 7-day window, all recent results are discarded and replaced by an all-time query. The caller receives a silently different dataset. The fallback path has no test coverage.

findings.label: Missing tests for FeedService
findings.detail: getFeed, getTrending (including the fallback branch), and getNewReleases have no test coverage. The PUBLISHED filter in feed queries is unverified by tests. ArtistsService.apply non-atomic path is also untested.
